rules.statement: A lessee cannot refuse to pay rent on the ground that the lessor had no title to the premises leased at the date of the lease, but he may prove that since the tenancy commenced the landlord's title has expired and that he has been evicted by title paramount.
rules.supporting_quote: It is sound law that a lessee cannot refuse to pay rent on the ground that the lessor had no title to the premises leased at the date of the lease. It is equally good law, however, that he may prove that since the tenancy commenced the landlord's title has expired and that he has been evicted by title paramount.
